payload.content:
Done. Here's what was built:

**File structure (per folder rules):**
```
index.html
css/style.css
js/app.js
```

---

**All MVP features:**

| Feature | What's in it |
|---|---|
| Greeting | Time-based phrase (morning/afternoon/evening/night), live clock, full date |
| Focus Timer | 25-min countdown, Start / Stop / Reset, Web Audio beep on finish |
| To-Do List | Add, edit (modal), check off, delete, persisted to LocalStorage |
| Quick Links | Add label + URL, opens in new tab, delete, persisted to LocalStorage |

**3 Challenges implemented:**
1. **Light / Dark mode** — toggle button in the header, respects `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit, saves preference
2. **Custom name in greeting** — "Set Name" button opens a modal, name persisted to LocalStorage, shows in the `// YourName` heading
3. **Prevent duplicate tasks** — case-insensitive check on add and edit; shows an inline error if a duplicate is detected

**Bonus (not required but included):** Sort toggle on the to-do list + configurable Pomodoro duration — those were two of the other challenge options and cost nothing extra.

To deploy to GitHub Pages: commit everything, push to GitHub, then enable Pages from `Settings → Pages → Deploy from branch (main / root)`.
